card.name: Missed-dose instructions: word before 'missed'
card.fires_on: Small words such as 'it', 'is' or a drug name inside 'If a dose ... is missed' sentences, right before the missed-dose outcome or the 'almost time for the next dose' clause. It also fires weakly on 'if you lose' and on words before failure-type terms.

modes.label: Missed dose wording
modes.description: The word right after 'If a dose' or the drug name, just before 'is missed'.
modes.example: If a dose of ALECENSA<< is>> missed or vomiting occurs after taking a dose

modes.label: Almost time for next dose
modes.description: The word 'it' after 'if' or 'unless', before 'is almost time for the next dose'.
modes.example: If<< it>> is almost time for the next dose,

modes.label: Before failure or loss
modes.description: A linking word before a bad outcome such as losing or organ problems.
modes.example: being a good sport means not complaining or getting mad if<< you>> lose.

card.writes: It pushes toward odd non-English tokens and away from 'failure' and 'fail' words, so there is no clear help for the next word.
card.plain: It lights up in the missed-dose instructions, on the little word just before 'is missed' or 'almost time for the next dose'.
